_comment: Hypothetical simulator scenarios. These are NOT historical observations. Entity ids, seed variables and analog events must exist in data/knowledge_base (validated at load). input_range is the accepted UI/API range; the ML model's validated domain is separate (from the model artifact) and is checked at inference time.

oil_price_change_pct.label: Crude oil price change
oil_price_change_pct.definition: Change in the Brent crude price over the simulated 5 NSE trading sessions

usdinr_change_pct.label: USD/INR change
usdinr_change_pct.definition: Change in rupees per US dollar over the simulated 5 sessions (+ = rupee weaker)

inflation_change_pct.label: Inflation change
inflation_change_pct.definition: Change in the inflation rate (percentage points). Graph-only: the quantitative model has no inflation input

us10y_change_bp.label: US 10Y Treasury yield change
us10y_change_bp.definition: Change in the US 10-year yield over the simulated 5 sessions

sp500_change_pct.label: S&P 500 change
sp500_change_pct.definition: Change in the S&P 500 over the simulated 5 sessions

gold_change_pct.label: Gold price change
gold_change_pct.definition: Change in the gold price over the simulated 5 sessions

policy_rate_change_bp.label: US policy rate change
policy_rate_change_bp.definition: Change in the federal funds target. Graph-only: the quantitative model has no policy-rate input

scenarios.description: A disruption to global crude supply raises oil prices; transmission to India via import costs, inflation, the rupee and energy-intensive sectors.
limitations: Supply-driven and demand-driven oil moves are not distinguished by the model.
Indian retail fuel prices are partly administered; pass-through to OMCs depends on policy.

scenarios.description: Escalating conflict in the Middle East raises geopolitical risk, the oil risk premium and safe-haven demand.
limitations: Without market shock parameters the model has no inputs; only graph pathways are returned.
Israel-specific relationships apply only if Israel is involved; this scenario does not name Israel.

scenarios.description: A surprise change in US monetary policy moves Treasury yields and the dollar, affecting capital flows to India.
limitations: The policy-rate parameter drives the graph only; model estimates come from the yield, FX, equity and gold parameters.

scenarios.description: Higher US tariffs on Chinese goods raise import costs, hit Chinese export demand and may shift supply chains.
limitations: Tariff magnitude itself is not a model input; only the market shocks you specify are.

scenarios.description: A pandemic-style shock disrupts demand and supply chains; specify the market moves you want to explore.
limitations: The knowledge base has no pandemic-specific relationships; the graph only follows the variables you shock.
The only historical pandemic episode (COVID-19, 2020) is a single, extreme observation.
